preregistered_commitment: 第二批 400 局、合并 300 张图、沿用 Hoeffding 口径、结果无条件报告
user_instruction: P2 新增 400 局，seed 930002（全新地图），其余参数不变；同时执行 P6：39 vs ppo20，200 局，seed 930001。

merge.method: Concatenate records, namespace map/game IDs by batch, count each paired map once; pool wins over 600 games, never average batch percentages unweighted.
merge.map_overlap_policy: Require 200 unique new map hashes, disjoint from the original 100; stop and report any overlap, do not substitute seed.

P6.map_policy: Require same map hashes, map IDs and seats as original P2.

reporting.caveat: Extension was requested after observing the first 200 games (122 wins). Retain requested nominal fixed-look Hoeffding calculation; it is not a time-uniform or optional-stopping-adjusted confidence interval. Report both batches, do not present the pooled interval as a newly preregistered independent confirmation.

stopping_rules: Run exactly 400 new P2 games and 200 P6 games regardless of observed win rate.
No interim significance stopping, extra batches, seed changes, best-run selection, or automatic retries.
On technical error/nonfinite outputs/source hash drift/map overlap: stop, preserve evidence and report; no automatic formal rerun.
outputs: Separate new output files; original protocol, results, summary and conclusion stay unchanged.
